name: io.github.Abhinav-Prabhakar/book-downloader-mcp
title: Book Downloader (LibGen)
description: Search Library Genesis and download ebooks with MD5 verification and mirror failover.

environmentVariables.name: LIBGEN_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where downloaded books are saved. Defaults to the server's working directory.

environmentVariables.name: LIBGEN_MIRROR
environmentVariables.description: Pin a specific LibGen+ mirror instead of discovering one automatically.
